ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (v0.39.1)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description:
DEUTSCH — Aragorn – Armee der Toten
Rette Aragorn, schmiede Andúril neu und befreie 13 Geisterkrieger in einer zusammenhängenden Questreihe. Beschwöre eine Geisterarmee mit sechs Klassen, nutze den Königlichen Befehl, mächtige Blitze, Andúrils Rundumschlag und Aragorns EMP-Sturm. Gegnerstärke, Geisterrüstung und Fähigkeiten sind einstellbar.
ENGLISH — Aragorn – Army of the Dead
Rescue Aragorn, reforge Andúril, and release 13 spectral warriors in a connected quest campaign. Summon an army across six classes and wield the King's Command, devastating lightning strikes, Andúril's sweeping attack, and Aragorn's EMP Storm. Adjust quest difficulty, spirit armor, and abilities in the mod settings.
v0.39.1 | RimWorld 1.6 | The Aragorn rescue fortress retains its 77x65 map, unbroken deep-water moat, outer wall, nested vaulted prison and original rescue progression. Four open-air positions of Profaned bowmen now defend real stone barricades: the old watchhouses have been removed. Two aggressive skeleton detachments defend the inner keep. There is NO PREBUILT BRIDGE when the player arrives. The player must bring a colonist to the southern bank and use a rescue-specific 'Prepare crossing' gizmo to lay a 3x7 passable causeway over genuinely deep water. This avoids an unplayable quest: vanilla RimWorld cannot normally construct bridges over WaterDeep. No additional bridge mod is needed. Old rescue maps remain compatible; all six spectral trials, weapon and art assets are untouched.
